mapper.insert: INSERT INTO basic_activity_logs ( user_id, action_type, http_method, request_uri, ip_address, user_agent, response_code, request_body_summary ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{actionType}, #{httpMethod}, #{requestUri}, #{ipAddress}, #{userAgent}, #{responseCode}, #{requestBodySummary} )
